examples.description: Put a b-roll track back underneath the other b-roll tracks

description: Move a track to position within its own role. Position 0 is the lowest: its pictures draw first, so every later video-broll or text track draws over it. Tracks of other roles keep their order; text always draws over video. Locked tracks may be reordered. Refuses an unknown track_id or a position past the role's last track, naming the fix.

position.description: 0-based position among the tracks of the same role; 0 draws lowest.
